title: ContextSafe receipt delta 0.1
$comment: The output of `contextsafe receipt diff` (B-037, docs/04-ARCHITECTURE.md section 7): a deterministic, envelope-free, value-minimized comparison of two compatible contextsafe-receipt-v0.1 documents. Reference-only and ungoverned: no clinical, community, laboratory, legal, security, or accessibility review of this contract has happened. JSON Schema validates structure only; the runtime additionally requires both receipts to share case_id, rule_set_sha256, schema versions, concept and checkpoint sets, and rule bindings, and rejects the pair otherwise.
x-contextsafe-semantic-constraints: receipts.before.payload_sha256 and receipts.after.payload_sha256 are the recomputed payload hashes of the two input documents, each of which had to match the hash the document declared; agreement is an internal-consistency check and verifies no signature, approval, or evidence
both receipts are unsigned and carry no trusted time, so before and after are the caller's labels and the delta proves nothing about which run came first
rules is ordered by rule_id and contains exactly the rule identifiers both receipts share; the runtime refuses a pair whose rule sets differ
every rule lands in exactly one summary count, so the summary values sum to the length of rules
changed is true exactly when change is not unchanged; evidence_sha256s_changed compares the sorted evidence hash lists and is independent of changed

limitations.$comment: Closed like the compiled-plan and compiled-pack limitation sets: slugs in a fixed order, no room for free text. Changing them requires a new contract version.

runner_version_changed.$comment: Whether the two receipts name different runner versions. A flag rather than the versions themselves: the delta says that the runner changed, and the receipts say what it changed from and to.

summary.$comment: One count per change code; a code may not be silently dropped from or added to a delta summary.

rule_change.$comment: regressed is pass to fail, indeterminate, or blocked; improved is the mirror; changed_other is any other difference in status or reason, including a move into or out of not_applicable, which the shared rule set does not explain.

rule_delta.$comment: Statuses, reasons, flags, and a closed change code. No expected, observed, or evidence hash is copied through, and no semantic value can appear.
